if: the document is a refund voucher referred to in clause (e) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 51 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the refund voucher MUST carry the signature or digital signature of the supplier or his authorised representative
note: One mandatory particular of rule 51(k), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: signature or digital signature of the supplier or his authorised representative.
